decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle through most of the shift. It holds 256 t at 15.4 g/t, about 127 oz. Central is truck-limited: loader inflow is 159 t/h against 91 t/h truck capacity. Taking LH-06 from C564-01, the lowest-grade Central stope at 5.8 g/t, costs almost no hauled ounces. Travel is 0.49 h. Este inflow would rise from 36 to about 78 t/h against 72 t/h truck capacity, so the stope is mostly drawn down by 17:00. I did not take a development loader: LH-09 costs 4.0 oz/h and LH-08 costs 1.9 oz/h. The estimate is roughly 36 t/h of spare Este truck capacity over about 6.5 h, which is about 230 t at 15.4 g/t.

Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (LH-01 and LH-04, likely back about 13:30). Keep LH-06 at E595-06, which has the highest grade, 15.4 g/t. LH-08 goes to C590-05: it arrives about 10:07 and loads about 200 t at 7.5 g/t, which is about 48 oz. It gives up preparacion development at 1.9 oz/h for about 6.9 h, which is about 13 oz, so the net is about 35 oz. LH-10 leaves PM at 11:00 and goes to C564-01, which has no loader. It loads about 165 t at 5.8 g/t from 11:30, which is about 31 oz, and costs no development. Central's stockpile has room (269 of 450 t). I left LH-09 on the critical-path heading at 4.0 oz/h. No reserves are activated because no stope was stopped.

Keep LH-06 on E595-06 (15.4 g/t, ~20 oz/h) and LH-08 on C590-05 (~7 oz/h vs 1.9 dev cost). LH-10 leaves PM at 11:00 with no home loss and reaches E569-08 (8.5 g/t, 305 t) ~11:30, covering until LH-03 returns (~12:50), about 9+ oz. Not taking LH-09 from critical-path DS-E543-02 (4 oz/h) since the gain (~7 oz/h for ~3 h, less travel) is marginal. Radio and CMMS agree on all three failures. Reserves can't be activated since no stope is stopped.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
